sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Paperclip is an open-source app for managing a team of AI agents like a company. You set goals, give agents roles in an org chart, set budgets, and track their work and costs from one dashboard.
sixtySeconds.problem: Running many coding agents at once quickly becomes chaos: you lose track of who is doing what and how much it costs. Paperclip adds a task manager, org chart, budgets and approval gates on top of your existing agents.
whoFor: People running many Claude Code, Codex or OpenClaw agents at once
Founders experimenting with autonomous AI teams
Managers who want budgets and approvals for agent work
Teams mixing human and AI workers
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if you want to coordinate several agents toward business goals with cost control and review gates. It manages agents you bring; it isn't an agent itself.
requirements: One or more agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Cursor, Gemini CLI and others)
API keys or subscriptions for those agents

overview: Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI. It looks like a task manager, but underneath it has org charts, budgets, governance, goal alignment and agent coordination. You define a goal, hire a team of agents for roles like CEO, CTO or engineer, approve the strategy and budget, and monitor from the dashboard.

Any agent that can receive a heartbeat can join, including OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Hermes. Agents wake for assigned work, follow-ups or schedules, and delegation flows up and down the org chart. Tasks link to company goals so agents get the context behind their work.

Budgets can be set per company, agent or project, with alerts and automatic pauses at limits. Review and approval stages, multi-organization support, and task threads with plans, files and run history are built in. It is self-hosted and needs no Paperclip account; a cloud version has a waitlist.

troubleshooting.problem: npx fails with E404 for paperclipai
troubleshooting.solution: A private registry in ~/.npmrc may be used. Run npx --registry https://registry.npmjs.org paperclipai@latest onboard --yes.
Use authenticated mode with a private-network bind such as Tailscale, or deploy the server with Docker.
It keeps existing config. Use npx paperclipai configure.
